newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 33.6 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 33.6 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Wednesday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.72 percent and 17.58 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 33.695 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 33.595 billion.
The issues were offered with no par values or minimum acceptable prices set in advance by the ministry.
Bids received 22,893.7 million levs 10,801.4 million levs
Avg price of bids 96.41 pct 85.04 pct
Bids approved 22,893.7 million levs 10,701.4 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.72 pct 17.58 pct
